children: The agreement will make Shell’s vehicle products available to motorists across several governorates as part of their regular visits to TAQA Petroleum stations. The range includes Shell Helix for passenger cars, Shell Advance for motorcycles, Shell Rimula for heavy-duty vehicles, Shell Spirax transmission fluids, and Shell coolants.

By combining Shell Lubricants Egypt’s technical expertise and product range with TAQA Petroleum’s retail footprint, the collaboration aims to serve the maintenance requirements of private motorists and commercial vehicle operators through a single distribution network.
The expanded offering will cover products intended for cars, motorcycles, and commercial and heavy-duty vehicles.

“We are always keen to be closer to the people who use Shell Lubricants’ products in their everyday lives. Drivers have different needs depending on their vehicles, how they use them and the conditions they operate in, and our role is to make sure they can easily find the right solution when they need it. Through this partnership with TAQA Petroleum, our full product range will soon be available across its network, making it more convenient for motorists across Egypt to access the right product for their needs,” said Haitham Yehia, Chairman and CEO of Shell Lubricants Egypt.

Mohamed Nafea, Managing Director of TAQA Petroleum, commented: “We are pleased to collaborate with Shell Lubricants Egypt to offer our customers a comprehensive range of its products, enabling us to meet the needs of a diverse segment of motorists, from private car and motorcycle owners to commercial and heavy-duty vehicle operators, through solutions that include engine oils, coolants and transmission fluids.”

title: ZAWYA: Shell Lubricants Egypt expands distribution through TAQA Petroleum service-station network
